sentences.text: Researchers used male mice to demonstrate that arcuate Kiss1 neurons, a specific group of brain cells, help control heat production in brown fat.
The study found that removing these neurons was associated with weight gain, while artificially activating them resulted in increased heat burning without higher food intake.
This heat production was driven by signals sent from the arcuate neurons to the dorsomedial hypothalamus, a specific area in the brain.
Additionally, using a gene-editing tool to remove a gene for a chemical messenger or a specific receptor gene in these neurons led to obesity by altering energy balance.
Finally, stimulating certain brain fibers with light showed that the Kiss1 neurons respond to signals through the melanocortin 4 receptor.
